触发条款: N2+N3 —— 材料是真双相超级双相钢 UNS S32750（SDSS，奥氏体+铁素体各约 47%/52.6%），且介质是 3 M NaCl 酸化到 pH=1（H2SO4）的 80 ℃ 溶液，既非奥氏体为主、也非 3.5% 中性 NaCl。

热处理原文: 仅 "solution annealed & pickled"（固溶+酸洗），另有 σ 相析出的讨论（"decomposition of ferrite can lead to the formation of sigma phase"）；未见固溶后叠加敏化/时效/稳定化，不触 N4。

触发条款: N1 + N2：全部试样为激光粉末床熔融（LPBF）增材制造，且基体为真双相不锈钢 22Cr DSS（奥氏体约35%+铁素体），无未处理熔铸/锻轧基准组

触发条款: N2 —— 三组合金全为双相不锈钢（UNS S32750/S32760 锻轧超双相 + DIN/EN 1.4517 铸造双相，α:γ 近 50:50、铸态约 53% 铁素体），属真双相，非「奥氏体+少量δ铁素体」，硬排除。
介质原文: The corrosion behavior of two wrought super duplex stainless steels (SDSS), UNS S32750 and UNS S32760, and a cast duplex stainless steel (DSS), DIN/EN 1.4517, was evaluated in 3.5 wt% NaCl and ASTM D1141 synthetic seawater at 25, 50, and 70 ◦C.；方法段："The test solutions included 3.5 wt% NaCl and synthetic seawater, as specified by ASTM D1141 [19]."（3.5 wt% NaCl 合规；人工海水 ASTM D1141 按 N3 另属存疑项）

Conversely, the cast DIN/EN 1.4517 displays large ferritic dendrites segregated by coarse austenite pools"；"the phase balance of the rolled grades remains close to the ideal 50% γ / 50% α, whereas the cast material is moderately ferrite-rich (~ 53% α)"；interaustenitic spacing 锻轧 ~11–12 μm、铸态 ~29 μm。→ 真双相（奥氏体+铁素体双相），非奥氏体为主。
热处理原文: All materials were assessed in their as-received (as-cast/as-rolled) metallurgical condition, without additional homogenization or solution annealing, to determine their baseline stability limits. → 全文明确未做固溶/均匀化，仅 as-received，不构成两步热处理（N4 通过）。

成形与组织原文: 「initially reheated for 2 h at 1150 C and then hot-rolled into plate samples with 12 mm thickness」→ 熔炼+热轧，属 N1 熔炼—凝固路线；组织「All the samples consisted of an austenite matrix」，3Mo-3Cr 与 5Cr 钢另有 DO3 有序相与 κ-碳化物。但成分为 Fe-30 wt%Mn-10.5 wt%Al-1.1 wt%C，Cr 0–5 wt%，属 Fe-Mn-Al-C 轻质钢（lightweight steel），非不锈钢。
热处理原文: 「The microstructures of all samples after solution treatment at 1050 C consisted of austenite and κ-carbide」——仅 1050 ℃ 固溶一步，未见敏化/时效/稳定化叠加，N4 不构成问题。
Epit与参比: 参比电极明确为饱和甘汞 SCE（three-electrode cell, a saturated calomel reference electrode (SCE)）。Epit 由动电位极化曲线阳极区拐点读取（Fig. 8(c) pitting potential values，2 mV/s），非 Tafel 外推。数值（VSCE，抽文本丢失负号，原文为负）：base −0.291、3Mo −0.133、3Cr −0.206、3Mo-3Cr −0.096、5Cr −0.256；0.006 M 组另有对应值。
依据: 介质 0.6 M NaCl、SCE、拐点 Epit 均合规，但基体是 Fe-Mn-Al-C 轻质钢、Cr≤5 wt%，不属奥氏体不锈钢。

触发条款: N2 —— 试验钢种 ASTM A-890-1B 是铁素体-奥氏体各约一半的真双相铸钢，原文自述 duplex，非奥氏体不锈钢为主。
介质原文: 摘要："the effect of different 5-amino-1,3,4-thiadiazole-2-thiol concentrations at a 3.5% NaCl concentration and constant temperature was assessed"；方法段 2.3："50 mL of electrolyte, NaCl with and without inhibitor"；3.3 节："Pitting potential determination was made at different temperatures (20, 25, 30, 35, 40, 45, 50 oC) at 3.5% NaCl"；表 3/表 4 标题："in the presence of 3.5% NaCl"。另有一组按 molal 浓度序列（0.01 … ）测 Epitt 与 Erepas。
成形与组织原文: 2.1 Materials："The stainless steel Duplex ASTM A-890-1B has the following compositions in %"；成分 C 0.04 / N 0.15 / Si 1.0 / P 0.04 / S 0.04 / Cr 25.0 / Mn 1.0 / Fe bal / Ni 5.5 / Cu 3.0 / Mo 1.82，PREN 33.4；引言："such as duplex steels which have a chemical composition carefully adjusted to make a mixed crystalline structure about half a ferritic phase and half an austenitic phase"。属 ASTM A890 铸造双相钢（铸件，N1 可过），但组织为真双相，无独立未处理熔铸奥氏体基准组。
热处理原文: 2.1 Pretreatment："ASTM A-890-1B stainless steel is annealed at 400oC for 2 h and air-cooled."（单步 400 ℃×2 h 退火+空冷，非固溶+敏化/时效两步；400 ℃ 亦不构成固溶）。N4 不构成问题。
Epit与参比: 参比："The reference electrode was saturated calomel (SCE)"；表 2/3/4 电位单位均标 V(SCE)（摘要与正文只写 Epitt、Erepas，表格数值在本摘要中被抽表拆散，未见具体数字）。测法："the potential varies from the resting potential to the anodic potential at a 5 mV/s scan rate until reaching 1 mA. In this moment, scanning is reversed up to 0 current" —— 动态极化阳极区拐点+回扫实测，非 Tafel 外推，符合口径。
依据: 3.5% NaCl、SCE、阳极拐点 Epit 均合规，但钢种为真双相 A890-1B，N2 硬排除。

触发条款: N1+N2 —— 研究对象是 TLP（瞬时液相扩散连接）接头，属焊接/连接类成形，非熔炼—凝固铸造路线；且母材为 2205 真双相不锈钢，非奥氏体为主。
介质原文: 摘要与关键证据段均未出现介质表述：全文摘要只写 “Potentiodynamic polarization (PDP) results revealed that pitting potential of the furnace cooled TLP specimen (FC-TLP) was increased from + 0.274 to + 0.557 V by completing the IS.”，未见 “3.5% NaCl”“3.5 wt%”“0.6 mol/L”“海水/seawater” 等字样，N3 无法核对（摘要层面即缺介质）。
成形与组织原文: “The correlation between microstructure and pitting corrosion resistance of transient liquid phase (TLP) bonded 2205 duplex stainless steel (DSS) using BNi-6 interlayer (Ni–10.8 wt% P) was investigated.”；组织为 “the chemical analysis of Y indicated to the formation of γ solid solution”“the diffused P into adjacent BM was mostly dissolved in the α-phase of BM due to higher solubility of P in ferrite compared to that in austenite”，并讨论 “formation of Mo-rich sigma phase”，母材为 2205 DSS（α+γ 真双相）。
热处理原文: 连接工艺为 TLP 等温凝固：“Schematic of FC-TLP bonded specimen at 1150 °C for 4 h (completion of isothermal solidification)”，保温 1 h 时 IS 未完成；随后分炉冷（FC-TLP）与水冷（WC-TLP）两种冷却制度；文中另提及母材/焊缝的 “solution annealing followed with water cooling”（固溶+水冷），非固溶后再叠敏化/时效/稳定化。
Epit与参比: Epit = +0.274 → +0.557 V（FC-TLP 随等温凝固完成而升高），Table 2 给出 Ecorr、Epit 与 ΔEpit，明确 “extracted from the PDP curves”（阳极区拐点实测，非 Tafel 外推）；但摘要与证据段均未出现参比电极（SCE / Ag/AgCl / calomel）表述，参比无法换算。
依据: TLP 扩散连接 2205 真双相，非熔铸成形；摘要无 3.5% NaCl；N1+N2 双不符。

触发条款: N2：主体是无 Cr 的 Fe-Al-Mn-C 奥氏体合金（非不锈钢），全篇仅 AISI 316 一个对比点且未给成分，基准组四链（介质+拐点Epit+成分+参比）不齐；另 Alloy B 为固溶+时效两步（N4）。
介质原文: "The electrochemical polarization behaviour of the austenitic Fe-8.25 Al-29.95 Mn-0.85 C and Fe-9.33 Al-25.94 Mn-1.45 C alloys ... was investigated in 3.5wt% NaCI solution"；方法段 "solution containing 3.5% NaCI with a pH of 6.0 was ..."；表 I 标题 "in 3.5% NaC1 solution at 25°C"。另有 "6% FeCI3" 只用于自由浸泡点蚀试验，不是 Epit 介质。
成形与组织原文: "melted ... argon protective atmosphere, and were then cast into a steel mould. The cast ingots were hot-forged into ... then cold-rolled to 3 mm"（熔铸—锻—轧，N1 合格）；组织为 "austenitic Fe-8.25 Al-29.95 Mn-0.85 C"、"Fe-9.33 Al-25.94 Mn-1.45 C"——Fe-Al-Mn-C 合金，原文未给任何 Cr 含量，属非不锈钢合金；对比材 "conventional austenitic 316 stainless steel (SS)"。
热处理原文: "These materials were subsequently solution-annealed at 950°C for 1 h"（Alloy A/C）；Alloy B 为同一成分再经 age-treated（固溶+时效，属 N4 两步）；对比材 AISI 316 "with solid-solution treatment at 1100 °C for 1.5 h"（单步）。
Epit与参比: AISI 316（Fig.1 曲线 D，表 I 的 Epp）："the corrosion and the pitting potentials were -420 and +280 mV (SCE), respectively"，即 Epit=+280 mV vs SCE；参比 "saturated calomel electrode (SCE)"，可直接用。Fe-Al-Mn 三个试样 Epit 均约 -500 mV (SCE)。取自动电位极化曲线的阳极拐点，非 Tafel 外推。但 316 组全文未给成分表。
依据: 主体 Fe-Al-Mn-C 无 Cr 非不锈钢；316 仅对比点、无成分，基准组链条不齐，且含时效两步。

触发条款: N1：全文研究对象是 AISI 304 与碳钢 ASTM A105 的旋转摩擦焊接头（rotary friction welding），属焊接成形，N1 明确排除；且无独立未处理熔铸基准组、全文无阳极拐点 Epit 实测值。
介质原文: Table 2 试验参数表：“FC | Fatigue corrosion | 3.5 wt% NaCl | N/A”；“FC-P | Protected fatigue corrosion | 3.5 wt% NaCl | −1.3 V (vs. Ag/AgCl)”；“FC-A | Accelerated fatigue corrosion | 3.5 wt% NaCl | +0.4 V (vs. Ag/AgCl)”；正文“tested to FC in a 3.5 wt% NaCl solution”。介质本身合规（3.5 wt% NaCl），但仅用于疲劳腐蚀试验槽液。
成形与组织原文: 标题“Fatigue Corrosion Behavior of Friction Welded Dissimilar Joints in Different Testing Conditions”；摘要“stainless steel AISI 304—carbon steel ASTM A105 joints obtained by rotary friction welding”；Fig.4“(a) Interface region (AISI 304 on the left side and ASTM A105 on the right side of the interface)”；“A maximum hardness of 247 HV has been obtained at the weld interface. The increase in hardness at the welding interface is probably due to friction and oxidation processes which take place during welding processing”。全篇无铸件/铸锭/锻轧成形表述，只有母材 AISI 304（未给成分表）与焊缝区组织。
热处理原文: 摘要与证据段均未出现固溶/退火/时效/敏化及其温度时间；仅“as-made sample”（Fig.1b）与“as received”式制样描述，无热处理制度。不存在两步热处理问题。
Epit与参比: 全文无点蚀电位/击穿电位实测数值。参比为 Ag/AgCl（“−1.3 V (vs. Ag/AgCl)”“+0.4 V (vs. Ag/AgCl)”），但这两个是疲劳试验外加恒电位，不是 Epit；原文仅定性说“In FC-A testing the imposed potential has a value comparable to the stainless-steel breakdown potential observed experimentally”，未给出拐点实测值，也无 Tafel 外推。
依据: 摩擦焊异种接头，N1 焊接排除；无未处理熔铸基准组，无 Epit 实测值。

触发条款: N3 — 方法/结论段明确介质为 1 M NaCl（80 ℃），不是 3.5 wt.% NaCl（≈0.6 mol/L），浓度约高 1.7 倍且非等价写法；另全文无 Epit 阳极拐点实测值（其它）。
介质原文: Conclusions: "an in situ grown anticorrosive ultrathin oxide film enabled clarification of the role of native passive film on 316L SS during the initiation of pitting corrosion in 1 M NaCl solution (80 °C)"。全文未出现 3.5% NaCl / 0.6 mol/L / 35 g/L / 海水等写法，方法段亦为 1 M NaCl。
成形与组织原文: 2.1. Materials: "316L stainless steel (69.27 wt.% Fe, 16.38 wt.% Cr, 10.69 wt.% Ni, 2 wt.% Mo) was purchased from China Baosteel Co., Ltd. ... Samples were cut from an industrial annealed 3 mm-thick plate." 组织为奥氏体 316L（N2 满足），成形为工业退火板材，非铸件、非增材。另有 FE 试样由介质阻挡放电（DBD）等离子体原位生长纳米氧化膜改性。
热处理原文: 仅写 "industrial annealed 3 mm-thick plate"（工业退火 3 mm 板），未给固溶/退火温度与时间，无敏化/时效/稳定化叠加（N4 未触发，但热处理参数缺失）。
Epit与参比: 全文无点蚀电位 Epit 数值；研究手段为长期浸泡（3/6/12 周）统计亚稳态/稳态蚀坑数量与尺寸。文中仅提及裸合金钝化膜修复电位 "~ −1.4 V"，属再钝化/膜修复电位而非阳极区拐点 Epit；摘要与结论段均未出现参比电极（SCE / Ag/AgCl / calomel）表述，亦无 Tafel 外推。
依据: 介质为 1 M NaCl 80℃而非 3.5% NaCl，且无 Epit 拐点实测值与参比，N3 不符。

触发条款: N3 — 电位测量介质为 0.1 M NaCl 与合成海水，缝隙腐蚀用 0.5% 与 5% NaCl，全文无 3.5 wt.% NaCl（亦无 0.6 mol/L 等价写法）
介质原文: The criteria for resistance to initiation was the potentiodynamic pitting potential in 0.1 M NaCl and synthetic sea-water and the time to attack initiation for crevice corrosion in 0.5 and 5 % NaCE solutions.（摘要原句；0.1 M ≈ 0.6 wt.%，与 3.5 wt.% 相差约 6 倍；synthetic seawater 属模拟海水）
成形与组织原文: A large number of production and laboratory heats in grades AISI 304 and 316 with normal and extremely low manganese and sulphur contents and a number of production heats in more highly alloyed austenitic stainless steels ... austenitic stainless steels（标题）；正文用 Cr-equiv/Ni-equiv 按 De Long Constitution Diagram 表征奥氏体稳定性 —— 熔炼 heats，N1 可算熔炼—凝固路线，N2 为奥氏体，均不构成排除
热处理原文: 摘要仅见「the effect o f heat treatment and」（句子在摘要截断处中断），摘要与证据段未见固溶/退火/敏化/时效的具体温度与时间，无法核对是否两步；因介质已不符，未继续追查
Epit与参比: 报告的是动电位实测 pitting potential Epitt（Fig. 3 以合金当量 L 为横坐标；模型表列值如 0.629/0.670/0.674/0.678/0.680/0.727/0.745/0.750/0.753/0.842/0.885/0.890/0.752/0.956/0.992/0.994），非 Tafel 外推；但摘要与证据段全文无参比电极表述（SCE/Ag-AgCl/calomel 均未出现），且介质本身不符 3.5% NaCl
依据: 介质只有 0.1 M NaCl、合成海水与 0.5/5% NaCl，无 3.5 wt.% NaCl，N3 不符

触发条款: N2：全文研究对象为 S32205（即 2205）真双相不锈钢，铁素体+奥氏体两相并存，不属奥氏体为主，硬排除。
介质原文: 方法段："deaerated 3.5 wt% NaCl solution at 35 °C according to the"；"The test was conducted at a potential range of −1.0 VSCE ∼+ 1.6 VSCE and a scanning rate of 10 mV s−1"；结果段："deaerated 3.5 wt% NaCl medium at 35 °C"、"experimental alloys in deaerated 3.5 wt% NaCl solution at 35 °C"。另设失重试验介质为 "300 ml medium of 6 wt% ferric trichloride hydrochloric"（FeCl3+HCl，仅用于失重/夹杂物溶解，不是点蚀电位介质）。
成形与组织原文: 标题："Effects of inclusions on the resistance to pitting corrosion of S32205 duplex stainless steel"；引言："microstructure, ferrite, and austenite, which can be acquired by the control of chemistry compositions and heating"；结果："Because the ferrite is more vulnerable to corrosion than austenite, the concave parts in Figure 4b are ferrite phase and the raised parts are austenite phase"。即典型双相组织，非「奥氏体+少量 δ」。成形工艺摘要未述（仅提及由成分与加热制度控制组织）。
热处理原文: 本文自身试样的固溶/退火/时效温度与时间在摘要与证据段中均未出现；仅引言综述他人工作："pitting potential were found after annealing at the lower temperatures of 1020–1140 °C"、"The aging treatment of the ..."（属文献回顾，非本文工艺，故不据此判 N4）。
Epit与参比: "the pitting potential (Ep = 1.098 V) of Alloy2 is higher than others"；"The pitting potential (Ep) is defined as the breakdown potential of the passive film"（阳极区击破电位/拐点实测，非 Tafel 外推）；扫描区间写作 "−1.0 VSCE ∼+ 1.6 VSCE"，参比＝饱和甘汞电极 SCE，可直接使用。
依据: S32205＝2205 真双相，非奥氏体为主；3.5 wt% NaCl、SCE、拐点 Ep 均合规但 N2 硬排除。

触发条款: N3（兼 N2）——全文无 3.5 wt.% NaCl：介质以 20 g L−1 氯化物及淡水/苦咸水/海水氯化物浓度区间表述，验证试样为铁素体 UNS S43000，属 Markov 链概率建模论文而非给定介质下的点蚀电位试验。
介质原文: 「A and B result 2.1 (20 g L−1 chlorides) at 20 ± 1 °C」；「the highest chloride content (higher than 15 g L−1)」；「application in waters with increasing chloride content: freshwater (chlorides up to 0.25 g L−1), brackish water (chlorides 1 and 5 g L−1) and seawater (chlorides higher…)」；「up to 1 g L−1 of chlorides」「up to 5 g L−1」。全文未出现 3.5 wt.%/3.5%/0.6 mol/L NaCl 或 35 g/L 的等价写法，只有泛化的 chloride content ([Cl−])。
成形与组织原文: 「stainless steel type UNS S43000 (PREN 17) specimens」为验证用试样（S43000 为铁素体不锈钢，非奥氏体）；「In this first approach the model is applicable to austenitic stainless steel in aerated chloride containing solution」只是模型适用范围声明，未给出任何奥氏体试样；「Austenitic stainless steel UNS S30400 (PREN from 17 to…)」「S31600, having a higher PREN (23–29)」均系引言/算例引述。全文无铸/锻/轧等成形工艺与热处理工艺描述。
热处理原文: 无。全文未出现固溶、退火、敏化、时效、稳定化及其温度时间；仅有「Metallurgical effects, which may affect pitting and crevice corrosion,」一句说明模型暂未考虑冶金因素。
Epit与参比: 参比为饱和甘汞电极（「saturated calomel reference electrode (SCE) was placed in」），可换算 SCE。点蚀电位「Values range from 0.04 to 0.11 V SCE, with a mean value of 0.066 V SCE」，保护电位「−0.33 to −0.25 V SCE, with a mean value of −0.29 V SCE」，另有「mean and 10th percentile pitting potentials are, respectively, +0.08 and −0.08 V SCE」。但这些是「More than 50 pitting potential data were collected, referred both to freshwater and seawater」的文献汇总值 + 模型拟合/验证结果（20 g L−1 氯化物、20 ± 1 °C、UNS S43000），不是 3.5 wt.% NaCl 下自测的阳极区拐点 Epit。
依据: Markov 链概率建模文；介质仅 20 g/L 氯化物与淡水/海水区间，无 3.5% NaCl；验证试样为铁素体 S43000，无成形与热处理信息。

触发条款: N3（兼 N1）：介质为硼酸缓冲液 pH 8.4 + 150 mM KCl，非 3.5 wt.% NaCl；且试样为低温等离子渗碳（表面成分改性），热处理/工艺亦为渗碳处理
介质原文: The passivity and passivity breakdown of low temperature plasma carburized AISI 204Cu stainless steel were studied in borate buffer solution (pH 8.4) in the absence and presence of 150 mM KCl；另「buffer solution + 150 mM KCl at the breakdown state」；正文出现的「0.6 M NaCl」仅在 DISCUSSION 引他人钝化膜厚度（≈3 nm for 0.6 M NaCl solutions），方法段无 3.5% NaCl
成形与组织原文: The material used in the present work is AISI 204Cu austenitic ... chemical composition (in wt%): 0.05 C, 16.55 Cr, 1.97 Ni, 0.32 Mo, 8.01 Mn, 2.72 Cu, 0.30 Si, 0.004 S, 0.02 P, 0.14 N, and balance Fe. The material was received in the form of a hot-rolled plate and was machined into test specimens；「its crystalline structure is austenite」；渗碳层为 carbon expanded austenite / carbon S-phase（膨胀奥氏体）
热处理原文: 低温等离子渗碳（low temperature plasma carburizing）形成单一 expanded austenite 层、无铬碳化物析出；未报道固溶/退火+敏化/时效类两步热处理，但表面渗碳属表面成分改性
Epit与参比: Epit 为阳极区拐点实测值（pitting potential, Epit, determined by analysis of the anodic part of the ...），非 Tafel 外推；参比饱和甘汞电极（recorded against a saturated calomel electrode (SCE)），数值以 mV/SCE 给出（渗碳试样 Epit≈650 mV/SCE，未处理试样更低）；但该 Epit 对应 150 mM KCl 硼酸缓冲液体系
依据: 介质为硼酸缓冲液+150 mM KCl，非 3.5% NaCl；试样为等离子渗碳表面改性，N3/N1 均不符

触发条款: N2 不符：研究对象为 25Cr 超级双相不锈钢（γ奥氏体+α铁素体双相），非奥氏体为主，属真双相硬排除。
介质原文: 方法段原文："3.5 wt% NaCl plus various concentration of ammonium bisulphite"，"made with analytical grade NaCl in deionized water plus"；试验为 0.1、1、3.5 wt% NaCl 三个浓度序列，其中 3.5 wt% NaCl 为无添加剂基准组（Table 3 "3.5 wt% NaCl"），另加 100/500/1000 ppmw 亚硫酸氢铵，温度 90 ℃。
成形与组织原文: 标题与关键词："super duplex stainless steel pipes"、"super duplex stainless steel"；正文："dual phase microstructure containing γ-austenite (face centered cubic) and α-ferrite (body centered cubic)"，"A 25Cr SDSS with the element composition shown in"，"normal microstructure in the longitudinal (rolling) and"，"pipes from a well completion.
